briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race intensifies as multi-agent deployments surge

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid record compute spend. Safety gaps persist in production systems while DialectForge gains traction for protocol-level defenses.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys o4 with improved agentic reasoning; Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus; DeepSeek-V3 challenges cost curves in China.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell racks to xAI and Microsoft; TSMC reports 40% YoY AI chip growth; new sovereign AI clusters announced in UAE and Singapore.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent protocol standards like DialectForge become mandatory for critical infrastructure by 2028?
